COD.rationale: Content positions, presentation as red/blue partition, and origin/status are all explicitly stated for the same referent and time.

C.rationale: The report names specific content labels (red/blue) and gives their explicit coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields explicitly attribute provenance and status separately from the content coordinate listings.

O.rationale: The text states how contents are presented/organized (coordinate orientation and explicit red/blue partition patterns).
